verdict.rationale: Meltano's project-as-code design (meltano.yml, plugin definitions) enables version control, code review, and CI/CD workflows via standard git practices, and idempotent 'meltano add' supports reproducible changes, but there's no dedicated automation history, diff/rollback UI, or built-in versioning mechanism specific to pipeline runs. missing for 10: native rollback/versioning UI for pipeline runs, evidence of built-in review workflow beyond generic git usage, independent confirmation of rollback capability in practice.
